{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_orders = df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]
df_clean = df[~df['revenue_clean'].isin([999999.99])]

# Filter out refunded orders
df_clean = df_clean[df_clean['status'] == 'completed']

# Now compute conversion rates by channel and customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(
    index=df_clean['channel'],
    columns=df_clean['customer_segment'],
    values=df_clean['converted'],
    aggfunc='mean'
)
print('Conversion rates by channel and segment:')
print(cross_tab)

# Compute overall conversion rate for each channel
df_clean['conversion_rate'] = df_clean['converted']
channel_rates = df_clean.groupby('channel')['conversion_rate'].mean()
print('\nOverall conversion rates by channel:')
print(channel_rates)

# Compute the raw difference (email - paid_search)
raw_diff = channel_rates['email'] - channel_rates['paid_search']
print(f'\nRaw difference (email - paid_search): {raw_diff:.4f} ({raw_diff*100:.2f} percentage points)')"}
